**Finding: Compliant — no redline.**

Section 24 (Assignment and Change of Control) sits at our preferred position on every material term:

- **24.1** — We may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent; only prompt notice and assignee assumption are required.
- **24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments are mutual, with a reasonableness standard on consent.
- **24.4** — Expressly negates any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control — the key walk-away risk is closed.

Section 13 (p0056) reinforces this by permitting transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 permitted assignment, and no termination trigger elsewhere in the agreement keys off change of control.
